items.headline: How global events can affect prices and everyday choices
items.summary: Changes in trade, energy, and economic policy can reach daily life through prices, jobs, and travel. Looking at the links between a headline and ordinary choices makes economic news easier to discuss.
items.question: Which price change have you noticed most in your daily life?

coachLeads.friendly: Have you noticed how a big economic story can quietly show up in everyday prices?
coachLeads.energetic: Here is a big topic hiding in plain sight: world events can change what we pay every day.
coachLeads.calm: It may be useful to look at how global economic changes reach our daily lives.
coachLeads.direct: World events change prices. Which change has affected you?

items.headline: AI assistants can now check current information and show sources
items.summary: Search tools let an AI check the web when a question depends on current facts. Citations also give readers a way to inspect where an answer came from.
items.question: When would you want an AI to search before answering?

coachLeads.friendly: You know how AI can sometimes answer with old information? Search tools are changing that.
coachLeads.energetic: AI can now check what is happening right now and show its sources. That changes the conversation.
coachLeads.calm: AI assistants are increasingly able to search current information and cite their sources.
coachLeads.direct: Current answers need current sources. AI search makes that possible.

sources.title: Google Search grounding in the Gemini API

items.headline: Why sports results make good conversation starters
items.summary: A score is only the beginning of a sports story. Players, tactics, atmosphere, and surprising moments give learners many ways to express opinions in English.
items.question: What was the last sports moment that surprised you?

coachLeads.friendly: Do you ever start talking about a score and end up discussing the whole game?
coachLeads.energetic: A great sports moment gives us so much more to talk about than the final score.
coachLeads.calm: Sports results can be useful starting points for discussing people, choices, and emotions.
coachLeads.direct: The score is not the whole story. What moment mattered most?

items.headline: Movies, streaming, music, and games compete for our attention
items.summary: People move between many kinds of entertainment during the same week. Talking about what held your attention is a natural way to practice preferences and recommendations.
items.question: What have you watched, played, or listened to recently?

coachLeads.friendly: Quick question: what has been winning your attention lately, movies, music, or games?
coachLeads.energetic: There is so much entertainment competing for our time. What are you actually excited about?
coachLeads.calm: Our entertainment habits move between movies, music, streaming, and games.
coachLeads.direct: We have endless entertainment and limited time. What is worth yours?
